lines: Hangar: Manifest checked twice. Your dependency is not on the shelf.
Hangar: I stock crates, not miracles. Pin the version, pilot.
Hangar: Shelf is labeled. The label is not the contents. Verify.
Hangar: Requisition denied until the lockfile stops improvising.
Hangar: One clean shelf beats ten clever piles. Tidy the manifest.
speaker: HANGAR
